name: Magnet crane
pros: Metal cost 3 (−40%); built mostly from scrap
balanceNote: Salvage Clans signature part (09 §4): better salvage, draws power. Declared as family "magnet", variant "crane" so that the id "magnet_crane" satisfies the checker's family_variant rule; it is balanced against the Recovery winch (crane) by hand: same tier and size class, cheaper metal, 40 kW draw, less HP and armour.
notes: Faction signature part (design/09). Art: patchwork welded box boom (P1 with P2 and bare-rust patches, weld beads), cab and generator with a salvaged Precursor coil, a scrap bin on the deck, electromagnet on a chain bridle with a scrap plate stuck to it, P3 hazard stripes on the base.
